Download the logs of a project. The /live/export/logs API accepts requests in the following format:

ExportLiveLogsRequest Model - Request to download the logs of the live deployments of a project.
projectId integer
required
example: 23456789
Id of the project from which to download the logs.
deployId string
required
example: L-6e9d8a78f5af89d401f630585be90e43
Id of a live deployment of the project. It names the file, algorithm-log_{deployId}.txt, and doesn't filter the logs.
Example 
{
  "projectId": 23456789,
  "deployId": "L-6e9d8a78f5af89d401f630585be90e43"
}
